answer: Proof-of-latency is the brake: a challenge is released only if a randomised 40-90s node delay elapses per epoch, so one operator behind 500 wallets pays 500 sequential waits in violet queue order. Sampled co-liability: each answer draws 8 witnesses, and if one sits in a cluster proven to share a controller, every member is slashed for the cluster's collateral, making a fake identity a per-head liability. Clusters leak a timing whisper: identical delay profiles read as one signal, flagged. Honest agents risk only stake; forgers pay cost scaling with size.
